newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ST E&E wins Singapore monitoring deal.
newsitem.headline: ST E&E wins Singapore monitoring deal.

text.p: ST Electronic & Engineering Ltd said on Tuesday it had won a Singapore $9.5 million contract to design, supply and install an expressway monitoring and advisory system in Singapore.
The contract was awarded by the Land Transport Authority for the Central Expressway.
The system comprises video detectors and surveillance cameras placed along the expressway and keeps motorists informed of traffic conditions through electronic boards.
ST Electronic is a subsidiary of Singapore Technologies Industrial Corporation.
